title: Monitoring billing data without moving it
executive_summary: Utilities must document the controls behind billing data. [E9] This paper describes a monitoring model where the agent runs inside the customer's own cloud account, so row-level data stays there. [E4]

sections.heading: The problem
sections.body_markdown: Billing errors that reach customers erode trust, and regulators now expect documented controls. [E9]

sections.heading: Approaches in the market
sections.body_markdown: Rule-based tools let engineers write tests table by table, which suits known rules. [E8] Monitors add coverage for drift and staleness without a test per table. [E1]

sections.heading: Our approach
sections.body_markdown: The Halden agent runs inside the customer's cloud account and connects with read-only credentials. [E4][E5]

sections.heading: Proof
sections.body_markdown: A regional water company cut incident triage from six hours to ninety minutes. [E2] [PLACEHOLDER: second customer result]
